correctness.rationale: For any N-cycle the sign row of the second-smallest point is negative at just one residue t_0 (the unique time sending it to the minimum). A signature-preserving unit must fix t_0 modulo N. With N=p^k, writing t_0=p^v h, p not dividing h, forces u=1 mod p^(k-v), so there are at most p^v<=p^(k-1) possibilities, including for k=1. For sharpness, enumerate orbit time j modulo p^k, assigning its rank by reversing all k base-p digits, including leading zeros. For a nonzero increment t of valuation a, positions below a agree under addition modulo p^k, so there is no lower-place carry into a, and the digit at a changes by t/p^a modulo p. After reversal that position controls the sign. Multiplying t by u=1 mod p leaves both the valuation and this first nonzero increment digit unchanged, hence it preserves the sign for every starting time. Multiples of N are fixed returns, and reducing all other times modulo N loses no case. There are p^(k-1) such units, so the bound also excludes every other unit for the constructed cycle. Transfer the construction to any ordered S by matching ranks. Independent exact enumeration using the time-increment sign columns gave maxima 2, 4, 3 at N=4,8,9; analytically the congruence and digit argument cover all prime powers.
residual_risks: The theorem counts only generating powers of a single permutation, not full signature fibers, and asserts no realization by a specified global interval map. The finite replay does not certify arbitrary p or k.

originality.rationale: Prime-cycle rigidity and composite-cycle collision existence are known, as is an exact broad family of composite signature fibers. Neither supplies the prime-power maximum in the fixed-cycle unit action. In particular, the strongest same-day exact fiber result has an explicitly different intersection with powers: for its block shifts with block count m and block width r, the preserving unit powers satisfy u=1 mod m (by the block step) and u=1 mod r (by the fixed within-block return rotation). The two congruences suffice for all signs in that family and give gcd(m,r) powers. For m=p^i, r=p^(k-i) this is p^min(i,k-i); it supplies the attaining example at k=2 but is strictly below the frozen p^(k-1) at every k>=3. The frozen digit construction uses multiple digit levels, not just a single pair of rotations. The universal upper bound in the fixed-cycle action and its attainment for all k are the distinct claim. No within-day priority is asserted.
residual_risks: Bounded primary search did not identify a further materially matching hit; this is not proof of priority. The standard digit-reversal device itself is not claimed new. Within-day order of the related exact fiber result is not established.

value.rationale: Recovering a cyclic time step from complete order comparisons leads naturally to ambiguity under changing the generator of the same orbit. The exact extremum resolves that ambiguity at every prime-power length, with a construction and no unquantified multiplicative loss. In particular every generator at lengths 2^k can be indistinguishable, whereas prime lengths are rigid. This is distinct from the known count of arbitrary alternative cycles, which does not tell how many time changes are invisible.
residual_risks: No arbitrary-composite extremum, classification of all maximizing cycles, or full inverse ambiguity count is claimed.
